title: High Density Resting State EEG of Phantom Limb Pain and Controls
description: Resting state high-density EEG (64 or 128 channels) recorded from amputees with phantom limb pain, amputees without phantom limb pain, and intact pain-free controls. Recordings last approximately 7 minutes and were acquired with eyes open or eyes closed, as indicated by task. The data are organised according to the BIDS standard and include session-level pain questionnaire phenotype data.
methods_description: High-density EEG data (64 or 128 channels) were collected during resting-state conditions with eyes open or closed. Recordings were approximately 7 minutes in duration. Session-level questionnaire data on pain are included as phenotype files.
